title: Managing Digressions and Parenthetical Clarifications in Lectures

sections.content: You know the digression and return markers *por cierto*, *a propósito*, *a propósito de*, *dicho sea de paso*, and *volviendo a lo que decíamos* from B2 Unit 28, as well as the additive connector *además* from A2 Unit 28. In university lectures, seminar discussions, and academic essays, speakers frequently need to insert a brief bibliographic note, historical aside, or methodological clarification before returning to the central thesis.

Each marker signals a distinct relationship to the ongoing discourse. *A propósito de* + noun phrase anchors a relevant side note directly to a term just mentioned (*A propósito de la bibliografía, conviene consultar la edición crítica*). *Dicho sea de paso* (placed between commas mid-sentence) slips in a brief parenthetical observation without starting a new topic (*Aquella reforma, dicho sea de paso, contó con el apoyo de los egresados*). *Por cierto* introduces a helpful tangent that just occurred to the speaker, and *volviendo a lo que decíamos* (or *volviendo al tema central*) explicitly closes the parenthesis and restores the main line of argument.

sections.title: Digression and Return Markers in Academic Discourse
rows: Triggers a relevant academic aside from a concept just named (*A propósito de la evaluación...*).
Inserts a brief parenthetical remark inside a sentence (*El archivo, dicho sea de paso, abre hoy*).
Introduces an incidental reminder or tangent (*Por cierto, mañana vence el plazo de la beca*).
Signals the end of the digression and resumes the main argument.

items.spanish: El seminario de humanidades, dicho sea de paso, duplicó su número de estudiantes este semestre.
items.english: The humanities seminar, incidentally, doubled its number of students this semester.

items.spanish: A propósito de la autonomía universitaria, el decano recordó la historia de nuestra facultad.
items.english: Speaking of university autonomy, the dean recalled the history of our faculty.

items.spanish: Por cierto, quienes necesiten convalidar créditos pueden acudir hoy a la secretaría académica.
items.english: By the way, those who need to validate credits can go to the academic office today.

items.spanish: Volviendo a lo que decíamos antes de la pausa, el enfoque pedagógico exige combinar lectura y debate.
items.english: Going back to what we were saying before the break, the pedagogical approach requires combining reading and debate.

sections.content: Do not confuse *a propósito de* ('speaking of' + noun) with *a propósito* ('by the way' as a standalone opener, or 'on purpose' after a verb). When a noun follows, *de* is required: *A propósito de la tesis, ¿quién preside el tribunal?*
